behaviors.notes: 5.42–6.5 s; dim at ~5.8 s, near beat 5.67 s (not verified as sync).

behaviors.mechanism: each shot is a different self-moving visual (particle ring breathing, ink smoke growing, gradient blobs drifting, neon light form waving) while the type stays still
behaviors.notes: Read from sheets a–c. 'Backgrounds move, type stays still.'

behaviors.mechanism: after showing the neon X visual full-frame, cut to the same visual inside the product editor UI (layers, sliders, timeline) with a small push
behaviors.notes: 9.75 s full-frame → 12.3 s inside UI (hold to 15.17 s). Duration = UI shot length (measured from scene changes).

behaviors.mechanism: key lines on a plain near-black card, small centered type, no animation, held 1.5–2.2 s
behaviors.notes: 'without the slop' 10.83–12.3 s, 'make stories that move' 15.17–17.4 s (times from scene changes / overview).

behaviors.mechanism: red wordmark cut on and held ~2.3 s, then cut to a small URL card held to the end
behaviors.notes: 17.4–19.7 s logo, 19.7–21.6 s osmo.inc. No logo animation visible in sheets.

behaviors.mechanism: lime app-icon square arrives oversized (fills most of the frame) and shrinks toward icon size with a fast start and long deceleration
behaviors.notes: Width 1251→745 px, f176–f210 @60 (2.93–3.50 s), rmse 0.001. Not a pop: no overshoot. Closest token Settle but the tail is nearly linear.

behaviors.mechanism: icon shrinks further while sliding left to become the avatar of a UI list row ('Private Money / For a public world')
behaviors.notes: Width 745→391 px f210–f234 @60 (Cruise 0.05); center-x 952→565 px in 283 ms, bezier (0.675,0.102,0.404,0.682) ~Flat 0.114. Element changes role instead of exiting (Elegant rule 8).

behaviors.mechanism: thin line curves drift on black, cut to a heavy motion-smeared black mark on grey, which resolves into a scribbled outline, then lime fill, then hard cut to the solid lime icon
behaviors.notes: 2.47–3.40 s, read from sheet a (states change every ~4–8 f @60). A 'construction → solid' variant (cross-family pattern).

behaviors.mechanism: WALLET / ACTIVITY / MENU nav pills slide in from the right, the row slides left and the pills merge into a single large MENU pill; later two pills stretch into the phone-UI card
behaviors.notes: 5.0–6.5 s and 11.1–11.5 s, read from sheets b and c.

behaviors.mechanism: bold condensed 'PRIVATE TRANSACTIONS' in lime holds, then a lime scribble/logo shape passes through and displaces/slices the letters (glitch)
behaviors.notes: 8.1–9.1 s, read from sheet b. Type enters as 'PRIVATE' then the second line (7.3–7.4 s).

behaviors.mechanism: app icon on a phone home screen fills from dark through an orange gradient to lime
behaviors.notes: 9.6–10.4 s, read from sheet c.

behaviors.mechanism: a lime card flips and flies across the frame; giant black 'PRIVATE' slides horizontally behind it, revealed inside a white band
behaviors.notes: 24.4–26.4 s, read from sheet e.

behaviors.mechanism: brand-identity applications (logo plate, app UI, type specimen, badge, social posts, poster) change by page-curl peels, one after another
behaviors.notes: 29.8–32.2 s, ~7 peels in 2.4 s (~0.3–0.4 s each), read from sheet f. Plays over the music fade-out.

behaviors.mechanism: quiet 3 s intro; the logo resolves to the solid icon at 2.93 s and the full track kicks in on the next beat (~3.34 s)
behaviors.notes: RMS 0.03 (0–3 s) → 0.13–0.17 (3–28 s). Icon solid −0.99 beat from the first tracked beat. Music-sync behavior.

behaviors.mechanism: music fades from ~29 s; 'Private By Default' and a small grey logo fade in/out over silence, then ~4 s of black
behaviors.notes: RMS 0.08 at 29 s → 0.004 at 34 s → 0 after 35 s (measured); fades read from sheet f.

behaviors.mechanism: a new flat backdrop color sweeps in as a diagonal wedge from a frame corner, revealing the next scene; used 5 times as the section divider
behaviors.notes: Coverage of incoming color measured on 5 wipes: f39-45 (6 f, 0.27,-0.19,0.74,1.19), f153-161 (8 f), f316-323 (7 f), f1234-1243 (9 f, 2% overshoot, Cruise 0.069), f1341-1349 (8 f). Bezier given is the rounded average; symmetric ease-in-out.

behaviors.mechanism: a small dark cube drops in, then unfolds into a folded-paper ribbon banner that flies in from the right with speed streaks; further ribbons stack below it
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet f_banner_build (f20 cube appears, f25 first ribbon, f30 second ribbon, ~f36 settled). Same device for 'SO.. LET'S PLAY A GAME!', 'READY?', 'Bingo!', 'Come to Frankfurt'.

behaviors.mechanism: text written left to right with a scribbled/smeared streak trailing the write head, as if drawn at speed; the scribble resolves into clean condensed italic
behaviors.notes: Banner lines f27-f40 (each line ~10-12 f, next line starts ~3-5 f later); end card f1354-f1440 builds every line and icon the same way. Read from sheets.

behaviors.mechanism: one continuous overhead camera flight over a low-poly papercraft landscape (coral land, faceted water, teal bridge, windmills, city) following a single truck; text tags ride along in screen space
behaviors.notes: f460-f1160. energy.png: steady optical flow 2-6 px/f (480w) with constant negative dx and no cuts for ~28 s; this is why motion% is 77 and rhythm is Flow.

behaviors.mechanism: small blue tag 'Follow this truck!' pinned to one truck in the swarm, tracking it through the flight; a yellow line trails the truck
behaviors.notes: f474-f570 read from sheet d_go_tags; a callout attached to a 3D object (tracking label).

behaviors.mechanism: orange hexagon badge with 3 / 2 / 1 on the truck grille; each number comes with a backdrop color switch (teal to yellow to blue to coral/black) and a camera angle change; intervals shrink (24, 20, 16 f) into 'GO!'
behaviors.notes: Number onsets read from sheet c_ready_count: 3 at f390, 2 at f414, 1 at f434, GO at f450 = accelerating countdown (1.9, 1.6, 1.25 beats at 117.5 BPM); not locked to the beat grid.

behaviors.mechanism: 1-2 frame white camera-flash blooms from the scooter passenger's camera ('snap it'), registering as a burst of 'cuts' in the histogram
behaviors.notes: Flashes at f333, f335-336, f348, f350-351, f355, f358, f368, f371 (sheet h_flicker). Main flashes ~13 f apart, close to one beat (12.8 f at 117.5 BPM), but too few to call it beat-locked.

behaviors.mechanism: the 'READY?' banner keeps its screen position while the scene behind it dissolves from the blue backdrop to the teal truck lineup (and the scooter passes in front)
behaviors.notes: f360-f370 read from sheet h_flicker.

behaviors.mechanism: truck drives toward camera, swings round and stops; rear doors open and a burst of confetti, paper shapes and balloons erupts with the 'Bingo!' banner, as the backdrop switches to yellow
behaviors.notes: f1240-f1290. Bbox width tracked (measure.py) but the truck turns while approaching, so the fit (rmse 0.16) is discarded. Same shape for the first drive-up f160-f188 (approx bez 0.87,0.12,0.46,0.95, rmse 0.04, perspective, approximate).

behaviors.mechanism: camera trucks right at a constant speed through every shot (scene content drifts left), never eased in or out
behaviors.notes: phase correlation per shot: 1.0-4.4 px/f @1920 (1-5.4% width/s), sd 0.1-0.6 px/f. Example shot f484-f573 shown; all shots fit Flat (0.010-0.029)

behaviors.mechanism: hard cut from one letter-set to the next (T, E, A, M, W, O, R, K), camera keeps the same drift direction so the move carries across the cut
after the letter-by-letter journey, a cut to a wide shot reveals the whole word TEAMWORK as one playground, with a small orange banner line above it
behaviors.notes: f574-f647; slow drift continues (about 2.5 px/f)

behaviors.mechanism: figures climb, pull and boost each other up structures, then celebrate together (high-five); acting built on cooperation
behaviors.notes: T shot f86-f124 (climb to top, high-five), box shot f301-f341; read from sheets

behaviors.mechanism: figure swings ring to ring along a rope line; body trails the arm and legs follow through on each swing (pendulum arcs)
behaviors.notes: E shot f160-f210; rings swing after being released; read from sheets

behaviors.mechanism: crouch (anticipation) then jump along an arc off a block onto a rope bridge; partner runs alongside
behaviors.notes: f313 crouch -> f327-f341 leap; read from sheet c_M_A_jump; camera drift prevents clean tracking

behaviors.mechanism: scenes never freeze: background figures keep climbing, a deer grazes, ropes sway while the camera drifts
behaviors.notes: motion 73.5% of the time; only 2 holds (the final word and the logo, ~3 s each)

behaviors.mechanism: cut to a static cream end card: PNC Bank logo with tagline and a single figure standing beside it; no logo animation
behaviors.notes: f648-f719, hold 3.0 s (metrics hold_max)

behaviors.mechanism: music-sync: the music builds through the letter shots and peaks around the wide TEAMWORK reveal, then decays under the logo; cuts lean slightly toward the beat
behaviors.notes: 136 BPM, pulse 0.51; cuts on beat 40% vs chance 32% (n=10), accents on beat 47%; median shot 5.1 beats

behaviors.mechanism: ring emblem (holding the word 'ENERGÍA') slides left from center to make room for the 'JUNTA AMPLIADA SANTIAGO 2015' text, which reveals beside it
behaviors.notes: Saturated-pixel centroid x 913 -> 677 px (1920 w), f1985-f2016, rmse 0.005; reaches 98% by ~f2002 (17 f) then settles; 2% overshoot is near noise. A long ease-out (fast start, long landing).

behaviors.mechanism: big orange sun disc rises from behind the horizon, fast at first then drifting up slowly while the camera trucks through turbines
behaviors.notes: Orange-disc centroid y 477 -> 198 px over f625-f668. Approximate: the disc is partly occluded by hills/turbines and the camera moves, so the centroid is biased. Profile: ~45% of travel in the first 8 f, then slow linear drift.

behaviors.mechanism: slow lateral camera truck/push through layered flat cut-outs; foreground pieces (pylons, turbines, pumpjack beams, dam walls) slide past large and fast, background slow
behaviors.notes: Pylons f386-f460, turbines/solar f680-f745, rig f792-f840, pumpjacks f852-f918 (sheets b, c). Foreground layers also wipe the frame between scenes.

behaviors.mechanism: a large dark (navy) foreground shape sweeps across the frame on the camera move and hands over to the next scene; also thick yellow bands sweeping diagonally out of the orbit-ring scenes
behaviors.notes: Navy wedges f240-f304, f466, f626-f636, f846; yellow band f160-f168 and f1330-f1342. Read from sheets; duration approximate.

behaviors.mechanism: a small blue disc surrounded by thin concentric arc segments rotating at different speeds; later thick orange/yellow ellipses orbit it like gyroscope rings and swell toward camera; used as opener and as the recurring section divider (bookend with the logo emblem)
behaviors.notes: f0-f168, f1320-f1400, and the logo emblem f1920-f1990 uses the same ring device (bookend). Read from sheets a, e, f.

behaviors.mechanism: wide-tracked orange caps 'COMBUSTIBLES FÓSILES' fade in per character left to right, hold, then fade out per character in a scattered order over ~3 s
behaviors.notes: Build f476-f506, hold to ~f540, dissolve f546-f620 (sheet b). Stagger estimated from sheet.

behaviors.mechanism: 3-line questions in condensed caps (small kicker / big orange accent line / small sub line) wipe in line by line with a horizontal mask; exit by lines masking out one after another; each holds 5-7 s
behaviors.notes: Q1 f1404-f1544, Q2 f1558-f1726, Q3 f1740-f1912 (sheet e). Timings approximate.

behaviors.mechanism: a thin vertical bar travels left to right across 'AMÉRICA LATINA / INTEGRACIÓN ENERGÉTICA', erasing the letters behind it; the bar then becomes the divider of the CEAL logo lockup
behaviors.notes: f2104-f2144 (sheet f). The divider stays and the URL types on beside it (f2152-f2176): element changes role instead of exiting.

behaviors.mechanism: Newton's cradle of planets/moons: end balls swing out and back in a pendulum loop while the middle ones stay; leads into hanging-tool and lab-object infographics
behaviors.notes: f1062-f1112 (sheet d); swing period roughly 1 s, read from sheet.

behaviors.mechanism: scenes change mostly through continuous camera moves and wipes; the 8 hard cuts do not follow the 129 BPM grid
behaviors.notes: audio.json: cuts on beat 0.375 vs chance 0.30, accents 0.34; 7 of 8 cuts land on a half-beat (0.875) but with only 8 cuts that's weak evidence; median shot 5.4 beats.

behaviors.mechanism: opening push-in from space onto a rotating globe, accelerating into Brazil, which becomes the mascot's flat stage
behaviors.notes: Measured on sqrt-area of the yellow Brazil shape f142-270 (rmse 0.016). Confounded by globe rotation (Brazil turns toward camera), so approximate. Pure ease-in with no landing: it hands off into a cut-free scene change at f270. Frame values repeat every 5th frame: 24 fps animation in a 29.97 container.

behaviors.mechanism: letters of a word ('population') arrive scattered and rotated below the headline and drift into their slots
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet b (f545-577). Each infographic statement is built from a big numeral with an ordinal + a headline word + a small secondary word that assembles letter by letter.

behaviors.mechanism: letters hop in one by one along an arc (like a ball bounce) and settle into the word ('economy')
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet b (f681-697); stagger approximate. Same family of per-letter builds: coins drop and stack onto '16 BILLION' (f971-1013), digits of '16.000' roll on beside a clapperboard (f3035-3075).

behaviors.mechanism: a word is written on in script, then repeated above in caps whose letters pop in from both ends inward, then a third stylised version builds: one word stacked in three typefaces
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet d: script write-on f1966-2001 (~35 f), caps converge f2029-2057 (~28 f), third line f2071-2092. Typeface stacking as emphasis is a signature of this video.

behaviors.mechanism: a graphic from the current fact grows or morphs into the next scene: rings spin off the '5' and open the yellow '8' scene, a coin expands into the network diagram, the 'O' of 'shoot' becomes a camera lens whose aperture opens to the next scene, a clapperboard stripe sweeps diagonally
behaviors.notes: Durations 8-20 f read from sheets b, c, d, e (f593-617, f1041-1048, f1945-1966, f3019-3035). Many 'cuts' in metrics are these fast graphic wipes.

behaviors.mechanism: circular icons pop in around a central $ coin one after another and dotted connector lines draw between them
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet c (f1048-1083); stagger approximate. The network then collapses back into the coin, which becomes the next transition (f1146-1167).

behaviors.mechanism: rubber-hose Brazil mascot walks in place while ground dashes scroll (speed lines), later dances in a loop beside a tiny film crew as the closing hold
behaviors.notes: Walk f288-350 (sheet a); dance loop f5011-5335 (sheet f). Bookend: the mascot opens and closes the story; scale gag with a giant shoe at f437-513.

behaviors.mechanism: on white, the flag mark tilts in while the FILMBRAZIL wordmark letters assemble left to right; partner logos (apro, ApexBrasil) pop in after
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet f (f5371-5389), then ~6 s still hold. Transition into it: cream panels slide away to white (f5353).

behaviors.mechanism: scene changes and text builds follow the sequence of facts, not the music: no clear pulse and cuts land on beat less often than chance
behaviors.notes: audio.json: pulse clarity 0.14, cuts on beat 0.20 vs chance 0.30, motion accents on beat 0.38 vs 0.30, median shot 4.96 beats (~2.3 s).

behaviors.mechanism: opening push-in from space onto a blue planet that continues without a cut over the horizon, into the city and down to the suburbs (~18 s single flight)
behaviors.notes: Measured on the planet radius (chord + top edge) f0-71, median-filtered, rmse 0.041: approximate. Radius grows 4x (310 -> 1067 px), growth rate 4 px/f at the start and 20 px/f at the end: an accelerating ease-in that never lands, it flies through. Mirrored by the pull-out at the end (f3550-3880).

behaviors.mechanism: scenes change by camera travel instead of cuts: the camera dollies through a car body into the next street, tilts down into a puddle and uses the reflection as the bridge, whips sideways with motion blur
behaviors.notes: Read from sheets c and d: car push-through f1135-1156, whip pan f1352-1373 (~20 f), puddle reflection bridge f1697-1746 (~50 f). 95% of frames are in motion; only 4 holds in 162 s.

behaviors.mechanism: camera drops past a falling icon bubble onto the textured ground plane, holds on the ground, then tilts up into a new scene (cyclist) where a bubble enters from the side
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet e (f2865-2940): ~15 f fall, ~45 f on the ground, ~15 f tilt up. Biggest optical-flow peak of the film (~113-117 s).

behaviors.mechanism: a white thought/speech bubble enters: its outline draws on as an arc, then a translucent fill fades to opaque white with a blue line icon inside; no scale overshoot
behaviors.notes: Counted frame by frame on sheet g (power button bubble): stroke f3412-3416 (~5 f), fill f3417-3421 (~5 f), opaque at f3422; then held ~17 f while the camera drifts, exit by cut. Curve fit failed (floor brightness contaminates the mask).

behaviors.mechanism: the bubble stays put and its icon is replaced by a cut (clock -> briefcase -> document; clock -> car) to show a character's chain of thoughts
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet b: swaps at ~f469/477/501 and f549/557 (8-25 f apart). Icons stand in for dialogue; no words are used in the body of the film.

behaviors.mechanism: flip-clock digits roll to 07:00 in close-up as the morning beat, then a match cut to the commuter
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet b (f437-461).

behaviors.mechanism: during the final pull-out, icon bubbles multiply over the city, the city dissolves into floating icon particles that drift together and resolve into the line 'Think Blue.' on white
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet f: particles f3850-3895, type resolves f3895-3925, holds ~3 s.

behaviors.mechanism: VW roundel appears on white after the line; the 'Das Auto.' tagline fades in under it a second later
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet f (logo by f4000, tagline f4030-4045).

behaviors.mechanism: a clear tonal pulse runs under a camera that never stops; cuts and motion accents fall on beat at chance level, so the music sets mood, not the edit
behaviors.notes: audio.json: 99.4 BPM, pulse 0.63, percussive share 0.02, cuts on beat 0.235 vs chance 0.232, accents 0.261, median shot 3.78 beats, avg 7.67 beats; loudness range 16.3 dB (quiet intro 0-10 s, denser sections ~35-72 s and ~100-155 s).
